skills.name: Emergency-Crafted Bullets
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ There is a 2% chance of activating when attacking. Affects self. Emergency-Crafted Bullets: Reload 3.13% of the magazine(s). ■ Activates during Emergency-Crafted Bullets. Affects all allies. Temporary Modification: Max Ammunition Capacity ▲ 1, stacks up to 3 time(s) and lasts for 5 sec. Critical Damage ▲ 2.96% for 5 sec.

skills.name: Modification Successful
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Only activates when Temporary Modification is at max stacks. Affects all allies. Critical Rate ▲ 1.96% continuously. ■ Only activates when Temporary Modification is at max stacks. Affects all allies with shotguns. Attack Speed ▲ 24.96% continuously.

skills.name: Miracle of Makeshifts
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects all allies. Miracle of Makeshifts: ATK ▲ 1.37% of the skill user's ATK. Mirrors the stack count of Temporary Modification for 10 sec. ■ Affects all allies with shotguns. Miracle of Makeshifts: ATK ▲ 14.31% of the skill user's ATK. Mirrors the stack count of Temporary Modification for 10 sec.
